title: awful
body: paid a lot a money for a planner that looks like a calendar from apple, can’t make any plans there. any tasks i’m trying to set just throws me out of the app. disappointed and frustrated. recently tried to get some help with my problem, haven’t received any. thank you for totally ignoring my problem! your app glitches all the time and doesn’t work properly. hope this helps for anyone who wants to pay these money for the same thing as an apple calendar.
author: Amalya2008
